name: Flexible Font
body:
You draw your magical power from more than one source.

Prerequisite: Font class feature, 3rd level.

Benefit: Select a font focus (from any font) that you do not have and add that font’s focus spells to your list of known spells.

Normal: You only gain bonus known spells from one font.
